issues.description: The solution allocates and operates on an N x N cost matrix (cost_matrix = [[0]*N for _ in range(N)]). Given the constraints (N up to 10^5) this is infeasible in memory and will fail (MemoryError) or cause severe TLE before producing an answer.

The implemented kuhn_munkres function is incorrect/unsafe. There are multiple logical errors in the matching/dual-update loop (wrong use of match indices, improper initialization/updates of distances/prev, and incorrect augment step). In particular the code updates u[match[j]] without guaranteeing match[j] != -1 (leading to unintended indexing u[-1] and incorrect dual updates).

The chosen architecture is overcomplicated for this problem. Because the cost of assigning an item to any non-original box is identical (W_i), the problem reduces to a linear-time solution: total_cost = sum(W) - sum(max weight kept per non-empty box). Using Hungarian/Kuhn–Munkres is unnecessary and causes performance and complexity issues.
No tests or example-based checks were included in the delivery (unit tests or simple input/output tests). Add at least the provided samples as automated checks.
